mapper.sql: user_id , age, weight_kg, height_cm, running_experience, weekly_mileage_km, best_half_marathon_time, training_goal, injury_history, preferred_run_time, preferred_terrain, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, age, weight_kg, height_cm, running_experience, weekly_mileage_km, best_half_marathon_time, training_goal, injury_history, preferred_run_time, preferred_terrain, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{age}, #{weightKg}, #{heightCm}, #{runningExperience}, #{weeklyMileageKm}, #{bestHalfMarathonTime}, #{trainingGoal}, #{injuryHistory, typeHandler=com.luyushuang.sportsadvisor.persistence.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{preferredRunTime}, #{preferredTerrain}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET age = #{age}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, running_experience = #{runningExperience}, weekly_mileage_km = #{weeklyMileageKm}, best_half_marathon_time = #{bestHalfMarathonTime}, training_goal = #{trainingGoal}, injury_history = #{injuryHistory, typeHandler=com.luyushuang.sportsadvisor.persistence.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, preferred_run_time = #{preferredRunTime}, preferred_terrain = #{preferredTerrain}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
